full_prompt_en: A square digital fantasy image shows a pale human profile facing right, dissolving into a densely patterned landscape of tiny colored forms. The face occupies the left half from a bright forehead and closed-looking eye to a long nose and rounded chin near the center. A bulbous multicolored headdress or hair mass rises from the upper left, built from stippled orange, green, yellow, and blue patches. The ear, cheek, and neck are covered with small ring-like cells, so skin and surrounding terrain seem to share the same porous material. On the right and behind the profile, a miniature landscape spreads in layers: rounded hills, slender spires, stacked platforms, and clustered architectural shapes are packed into shallow, dreamlike distance. Turquoise, cobalt, violet, lime, warm coral, and ochre sit side by side in restless speckled patterns. Near the lower left, larger rounded forms and dense multicolored dots press toward the viewer, while a small bright amber shape marks the lower center. The profile remains legible because its lit edge is smoother and warmer than the intricate background, even though the texture crosses both areas. Light appears to glow from several diffuse directions rather than one sun; pale gold on the face and tiny bright accents throughout the landscape separate the many layers. Edges of forms turn into repeated curls and cellular loops, and very little open ground remains. The surface has an intensely detailed, almost beaded texture, with small motifs repeating at different scales across skin, vegetation, and imagined structures. No readable text is present. The overall composition is exuberant and immersive, using a calm large profile as an anchor within a vibrating mosaic of saturated color and microscopic pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字幻想图像呈现一张面向右侧的浅色人脸侧影，逐渐融入由微小彩色形状密布的风景。面孔占据左半部，从明亮额头和似乎轻闭的眼睛，延伸到中央附近的长鼻与圆润下巴。球状多彩头饰或发团从左上升起，由点状橙、绿、黄、蓝色斑块构成。耳朵、面颊与颈部覆满小小的环状细胞纹，使皮肤与周围地貌仿佛共享同一种多孔材料。侧影右边与后方，微型风景层层展开：圆丘、细尖塔、叠起的平台和聚集的建筑状形体挤满浅而如梦的远景。青绿、钴蓝、紫、浅绿、暖珊瑚色与赭色在躁动的点状图案中相邻。左下附近，较大的圆形体量和密集多彩点向观者压来，中央下方有一处小亮琥珀色重音。尽管肌理跨过脸与背景，侧影依然可辨，因为受光边缘比繁密背景更平滑、更暖。光似乎从几个漫散方向发亮，而非来自一个太阳；脸上的浅金与风景里处处闪现的小亮点分开许多层次。形体边缘转化为重复卷曲和细胞式环线，几乎没有开放地面。表面有极其细密、近似珠饰的纹理，小图案以不同尺度重复于皮肤、植物及想象的结构之上。画中没有可读文字。整体构图热烈且沉浸，以平静的大型侧影固定一片由饱和色和微观花纹振动的马赛克。
style_prompt_en: The digital image builds a continuous world from minute stipples, cellular loops, and repeated jewel-like motifs. Large recognizable masses remain visible because their value and edge temperature differ from the surrounding micro-pattern, even while the same texture crosses both. Highly saturated turquoise, violet, cobalt, coral, ochre, and lime interlock without a neutral resting color. Small bright nodes pulse through deeper blue and purple passages, giving depth to a space otherwise packed from edge to edge. Forms merge by gradual changes of pattern density rather than by a conventional outline. A broad calm shape can anchor the eye while the rest of the field branches into miniature structures and curling details at several scales. Illumination is diffuse and internally radiant, with many tiny highlights rather than one cast-shadow system. The overall effect is hallucinatory and intricate, a seamless exchange between macro form and microscopic ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 这种数字图像从微小点痕、细胞式环线和反复出现的宝石般纹样建立连续世界。大型可辨体量之所以仍清楚，是因其明度与边缘色温有别于周围微观图案，即使同一肌理跨越两边。高饱和青绿、紫、钴蓝、珊瑚色、赭色和浅绿互相咬合，几乎没有中性色休息区。小亮点在更深的蓝紫段落中闪动，为原本从边到边塞满的空间添出纵深。形体靠图案密度的逐渐变化而融合，不依赖常规外轮廓。一块宽阔安静的形状可固定视线，其余色域则以不同尺度分枝成微型结构和卷曲细节。照明漫散且仿佛从内部发光，由无数小高光而非单一投影系统组成。整体效果迷幻而繁复，是宏观形体与微观装饰之间无缝的交换。
theme_en: A human profile dissolving into a densely patterned psychedelic landscape
theme_zh: 一张人脸侧影融入密布花纹的迷幻风景
name: DeepDream
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
